Module info5.sar
Package info5.sar.EventBasedMessageQueue.Impl

Class InternalChannelListener

java.lang.Object
info5.sar.EventBasedMessageQueue.Impl.InternalChannelListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
IChannelListener
public class InternalChannelListener extends Object implements IChannelListener
InternalChannelListener is an implementation of the IChannelListener interface responsible for handling message transmission and reception over a given IChannel.

This listener operates with two primary states for both sending and receiving data:

  • SendingState: Represents the stage of sending either the message length or the message content itself.
  • ReceivingState: Represents the stage of receiving either the message length or the actual message content.

The listener utilizes a MessageListener to notify when messages are sent, received, or when the channel is closed, enabling integration with other components interested in message events.

Constructor:

  • InternalChannelListener(IChannel): Initializes the listener with the specified IChannel and sets the initial sending and receiving states.

Methods:

  • disconnected(): Called when the channel is disconnected. Notifies the MessageListener of the channel closure.
  • read(byte[]): Invoked upon reading bytes from the channel. Manages state transitions and handles either the length or message content based on the current ReceivingState.
  • wrote(byte[]): Invoked upon writing bytes to the channel. Manages state transitions and notifies the MessageListener when the message content is fully sent.
  • setMessageListener(MessageListener): Assigns a MessageListener for handling message events.
